:::{#rem-newton-root-vs-model}
#### Two ways to read the Newton step

@thm-newton-model reads the [Newton step](#def-newton-step) as the minimizer of the [quadratic model](#def-quadratic-model),
which needs the Hessian $\matr{H}$ to be [positive definite](linear-algebra-special-matrices.qmd#def-positive-definite).
@thm-newton-linearized-gradient reads it as the root of the [linear approximation of the gradient](#def-gradient-linear-approximation),
which needs only $\matr{H}$ [invertible](linear-algebra-special-matrices.qmd#def-matrix-inverse).
[Newton's method](#def-newton-method) solves $\deriv{\vx} f(\vx) = \vzero_{p \times 1}$
by replacing the gradient with its linear approximation at each iterate,
so it looks for a [stationary point](#def-stationary-point) of any kind,
not only a minimizer.

:::
